title: Weekly digest, round 2 (1 of 4): the desk, now that everything is added by hand
question: As you said: a digest starts empty and staff add each thing from the calendar, from church news or by writing it; choosing a thing opens it in a dialog (next round), so the right side stays the preview. Each sketch is the admin panel's Weekly digest with five things added (one is a Members-only news post). Pick the layout; steer anything in the box. My recommendation: A. The preview gets the room it needs to show the email at a readable size (your #27 is about how the email looks), the list stays a short running order, and the three add buttons sit where the list ends. B hides the preview behind a button, so you can't see the email while you order things; C keeps the picker open all the time, which pushes what's in the digest below the fold.

options.label: A: The running order beside a big preview
options.thesis: The list of what's in the digest on the left (grip, picture, where it came from, title, when, ⋯), with From the calendar, A church news post and Something else under it; the right half is the preview, In the app or Email, big enough to read, with Copy for email and Send at its foot.
materials: three add buttons at the list's end
options.viewport: Dates at the top left, five things in order under them, the email at a readable scale on the right, Send under it.
options.risk: The list column is narrower than today's, so a long title wraps onto two lines.

options.label: B: One column of big cards
options.thesis: No side column: each thing is a large card with its picture and words much as people will see them, in one centred column; three dashed boxes at the end add from the calendar, church news or by hand. Preview, Copy for email and Send sit in the title bar; Preview opens the app and email full size.
materials: big cards close to the finished look
options.viewport: Dates and Saved at the top of a centred column, then the cards: Not on, Baptisms, the food pantry post, Christmas Day.
options.risk: You can't see the real app or email while you edit, only cards that look like them; four or five things fill the screen.

options.label: C: A picker always open above the list
options.thesis: Above what's in the digest sits a panel with tabs, From the calendar | Church news | Something else: the calendar tab lists everything in the dates by day, with calendar filters, and + Add beside each (or ✓ In the digest). The phone preview stays on the right as now.
options.viewport: Dates, then the picker showing Wed 16 to Fri 25 with three already added, then the start of In the digest; the phone on the right.
options.risk: The picker takes the top half, so what's actually in the digest starts below the fold once there are a few things.
